top_signals.title: 'Chinamaxxing' Boosts Inbound Tourism in China
top_signals.summary:
A BofA Global Research report says China is increasingly attracting tourists from other regions. Anna Zhou, BofA Global Research's China and Asia economist, discusses the trend.
Factors driving the trend include accessibility, affordability, and authenticity, according to Zhou. She discusses the findings on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: JPMorgan Unit to Argue Any India Regulatory Breach Was Technical
top_signals.summary: A JPMorgan Chase & Co. unit facing allegations of non-compliance from India’s market regulator is likely to contend that the issue was technical in nature rather than manipulative, people familiar with the matter said.
